verdict.rationale: Omarchy documents running Windows through a Docker VM with isolation from the host filesystem, which is the only evidence touching on quick VM creation, but it's limited to a single prebuilt Windows VM use case rather than a general-purpose VM creation/management workflow. missing for 10: evidence of a general VM creation tool (e.g. libvirt/virt-manager/QEMU integration), support for creating arbitrary Linux/other OS VMs, and any documentation on managing multiple VMs without manual configuration.
